summary: Porphy is the Hearthian winemaker of the Village who produces sap wine they call 'the Good Stuff,' though most villagers treat it as more of a digestive chore than a pleasure. Porphy ages each batch starting on the day of a significant local event.

behavior: Porphy refers to their sap wine as 'the Good Stuff.'
Porphy considers an iron stomach the mark of a true Hearthian.
Porphy flirts (unsubtly) with Gossan, according to Esker's signalscope log.
location: Porphy is found in the Village on Timber Hearth.
lore: Porphy makes sap wine that most Villagers consider a daunting digestive challenge rather than a pleasure.
Porphy attributes Hearthians' hardy hunter-gatherer lifestyle to ancestors surviving lots of bad food via trial and error.
Porphy begins aging each batch on a significant occasion, resulting in bottles labeled 'structural collapse' and 'house fire.'
Porphy hopes to teach Esker to tap trees and bring back lunar sap for 'moon wine.'
Porphy invites the protagonist, Gossan, and themselves to share a bottle of the Good Stuff after the protagonist returns from space.
